name: Zephyr Olden
source:
[i]"I have a lot to atone for."[/i]

[i]Anxious Researcher[/i]

The heroine's childhood friend and first love. Though he normally works as a researcher analyzing Legacies, he'll also join surface expeditions as a Sylphid.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=zephyr]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
